name: Tsukui Hidehito
source:
He has spent a lot of time with his childhood friend, Chiho, since they were kids,
and they were both accepted into college at the same time and moved to Tokyo together.
Chiho is always nagging him about this and that, and he wishes she would stop clinging to him.
However, deep down—even without realizing it himself—he harbors feelings for Chiho that go beyond those of a childhood friend.
It isn’t until Chiho starts dating Yuusei that he finally realizes his true feelings.
Though he regrets that it’s already too late, something strange happens at that moment.
